options_page_title.description: Browser tab title of the settings page. {1} is the app name.

options_status_saving.description: Discreet status pill while a change is being saved.

options_status_error.description: Discreet status pill when a change was refused or failed.

options_load_error.description: Error banner if the settings could not be read.

options_reload.description: Button that reloads the settings page.

options_dismiss.description: Accessible label of the button closing a notification.

options_undo.description: Button in a notification that brings back what was just deleted.

options_lock_banner.en: Block active until {1}. You can add, not remove.
options_lock_banner.fr: Blocage actif jusqu'à {1}. Tu peux ajouter, pas retirer.
options_lock_banner.description: Banner shown while a block is active. {1} is a time like 14:00 (or weekday and time).

options_lock_banner_plain.en: Block active. You can add, not remove.
options_lock_banner_plain.fr: Blocage actif. Tu peux ajouter, pas retirer.
options_lock_banner_plain.description: Same banner when the end time is unknown.

options_locked_tooltip.fr: Verrouillé jusqu'à la fin du blocage
options_locked_tooltip.description: Tooltip on controls disabled during an active block.

options_missing_one.en: 1 site shows Chrome's error page instead of your goal.
options_missing_one.fr: 1 site affiche la page d'erreur de Chrome au lieu de ton objectif.
options_missing_one.description: Banner when one blocked site lacks host permission. It is still blocked, with Chrome's own error page instead of the page showing the goal. Next to an Allow button.

options_missing_other.en: {1} sites show Chrome's error page instead of your goal.
options_missing_other.fr: {1} sites affichent la page d'erreur de Chrome au lieu de ton objectif.
options_missing_other.description: Same banner for several sites. {1} is the number of sites (2 or more). Never say the sites are not blocked.

options_chip_missing.en: Chrome's error page until you allow access
options_chip_missing.fr: Page d'erreur de Chrome tant que tu n'autorises pas l'accès
options_chip_missing.description: Tooltip on a site chip that lacks host permission (still blocked, with Chrome's error page).

options_permission_denied.en: Access not granted: those sites show Chrome's error page.
options_permission_denied.fr: Accès refusé : ces sites affichent la page d'erreur de Chrome.
options_permission_denied.description: Notice after the user declined the Chrome permission prompt. Never say the sites are not blocked.

options_groups_title.description: Section title: groups of sites that can be switched on and off.

options_groups_sub.description: One short line under the Groups title.

options_group_new.description: Button creating an empty group of sites.

options_group_default_name.description: Name given to a group the user left unnamed (max 30 characters).

options_group_count_zero.description: Under a group name when the group has no site.

options_group_count_one.description: Under a group name when the group has one site.

options_group_count.description: Under a group name. {1} is the number of sites (2 or more).

options_group_toggle_aria.description: Accessible label of a group switch. {1} is the group name.

options_group_missing.description: Tooltip and screen reader text of the small warning icon on a group with sites lacking host permission.

options_group_name_label.description: Accessible label of the group name field.

options_group_icon_label.description: Accessible label of the row of icons to pick from for a group.

options_group_sites_aria.description: Accessible label of the list of sites of a group. {1} is the group name.

options_group_delete.description: Button deleting a group and its list of sites.

options_group_deleted.description: Notification after deleting a group, next to an Undo button.

options_group_limit.description: Tooltip on the disabled New group button when the limit is reached. {1} is the limit (20).

options_group_full.description: Inline error when a group already has the maximum number of sites. {1} is the limit (100).

options_group_no_room.en: No room left to save more sites.
options_group_no_room.fr: Plus de place pour enregistrer d'autres sites.
options_group_no_room.description: Inline error when the groups no longer fit in Chrome's sync storage.

options_site_in_group.description: Inline error when adding a site the group already has.

options_site_covered.description: Inline error when a parent domain in the same list already covers the site. {1} is that domain.

options_custom_in_group.description: Inline error when adding one of Your sites that an active group already blocks. {1} is the group name.

options_site_input_label.description: Accessible label of the fields adding a site.

options_site_placeholder.en: Add a site or paste a link
options_site_placeholder.fr: Ajoute un site ou un lien
options_site_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the fields adding a site (a domain or any full URL).

options_site_remove_aria.description: Label and tooltip of the remove button on a site chip. {1} is a domain.

options_icon_users.description: Name of a group icon (two people), read by screen readers.

options_icon_play.description: Name of a group icon (play button in a circle), read by screen readers.

options_icon_mail.description: Name of a group icon (envelope), read by screen readers.

options_icon_news.description: Name of a group icon (newspaper), read by screen readers.

options_icon_cart.description: Name of a group icon (shopping cart), read by screen readers.

options_icon_chat.description: Name of a group icon (speech bubble), read by screen readers.

options_icon_game.description: Name of a group icon (game controller), read by screen readers.

options_icon_music.description: Name of a group icon (music note), read by screen readers.

options_icon_briefcase.description: Name of a group icon (briefcase), read by screen readers.

options_icon_heart.description: Name of a group icon (heart), read by screen readers.

options_icon_star.description: Name of a group icon (star), read by screen readers.

options_icon_globe.description: Name of a group icon (globe), read by screen readers.

options_icon_book.description: Name of a group icon (book), read by screen readers.

options_icon_sparkles.description: Name of a group icon (sparkles), read by screen readers.

options_icon_target.description: Name of a group icon (target), read by screen readers.

options_icon_coffee.description: Name of a group icon (coffee cup), read by screen readers.

options_sites_title.description: Section title for single sites added outside any group.

options_sites_sub.fr: Des sites à part, hors des groupes.
options_sites_sub.description: One short line under the Your sites title.

options_schedules_title.description: Section title for weekly time slots.

options_schedules_sub.en: Blocks that start on their own.
options_schedules_sub.fr: Des blocages qui démarrent tout seuls.
options_schedules_sub.description: One short line under the When title: weekly time slots start a block automatically.

options_schedule_add.description: Button adding a weekly time slot.

options_schedule_to.description: Word between start and end time, as in 09:00 to 12:00.

options_schedule_start_aria.description: Accessible label of the start time input.

options_schedule_end_aria.description: Accessible label of the end time input.

options_schedule_next_day.description: Small tag when a slot ends after midnight, e.g. 22:00 to 02:00.

options_schedule_days_aria.description: Accessible label of the weekday buttons group.

options_schedule_enabled_aria.en: Turn this slot on or off
options_schedule_enabled_aria.description: Accessible label of a time slot switch.

options_schedule_delete_aria.description: Label and tooltip of the delete button of a time slot.

options_schedule_error_days.description: Inline validation error on a time slot.

options_schedule_error_same.fr: Le début et la fin doivent être différents.
options_schedule_error_same.description: Inline validation error on a time slot.

options_schedule_error_time.description: Inline validation error on a time slot.

options_schedule_confirm.en: This starts a block now, until {1}.
options_schedule_confirm.fr: Ça lance un blocage maintenant, jusqu'à {1}.
options_schedule_confirm.description: Confirmation when a time slot change would start a block immediately. {1} is the end time.

options_schedule_confirm_yes.description: Button confirming a time slot change that starts a block immediately.

options_schedule_confirm_extend.en: This keeps the block on until {1}.
options_schedule_confirm_extend.description: Confirmation when turning a time slot on during a block would make the block last longer. {1} is the new end time.

options_schedule_confirm_on.description: Button confirming that a time slot is turned on even though it extends the current block.

options_schedule_paused.en: Off for now: turning it on starts a block.
options_schedule_paused.fr: Désactivé pour l'instant : l'activer lance un blocage.
options_schedule_paused.description: Note on a newly added slot that was added switched off because it covers the current time.

options_schedule_draft_note.en: Locked once added, until the block ends.
options_schedule_draft_note.fr: Verrouillé une fois ajouté, jusqu'à la fin du blocage.
options_schedule_draft_note.description: Note on the new slot editor shown during an active block.

options_schedule_draft_save.description: Button saving a new time slot during an active block.

options_schedule_enable_allowed.en: You can turn it on, not off
options_schedule_enable_allowed.fr: Tu peux l'activer, pas le désactiver
options_schedule_enable_allowed.description: Tooltip on the switch of a switched off time slot during an active block.

options_goal_title.description: Section title (the user has a single goal). Also the accessible label of the goal field.

options_goal_sub.en: Shown when a site is blocked.
options_goal_sub.fr: Affiché quand un site est bloqué.
options_goal_sub.description: One short line under the Your goal title.

options_quote_toggle.description: Label of the switch for the motivational line on the blocked page.

options_ending_title.description: Settings section title: what it takes to end a focus session before its end (pay a chosen amount, or type a sentence for free).

options_ending_money.description: Choice card title: ending a session early asks to pay the amount the user chose (a free way out always exists). It is accountability, not a paywall.

options_ending_money_sub.en: You can still skip for free.
options_ending_money_sub.fr: Tu peux toujours passer sans payer.
options_ending_money_sub.description: Line under the money choice: paying is never required, the user can skip it and type a sentence instead.

options_ending_free.description: Choice card title: ending a session early never involves money.

options_ending_free_sub.description: Line under the free choice: ending a session early only asks to type a sentence.

options_amount_label.description: Accessible label of the row of amounts to pay when ending a session early.

options_amount_other.description: Last button of the amount row: reveals a field to type any amount.

options_amount_input_label.description: Accessible label of the field where the user types a custom amount.

options_amount_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the custom amount field, shown next to the currency sign. {1} and {2} are the limits (1 and 500).

options_amount_error.en: Choose a whole amount from {1} to {2}.
options_amount_error.fr: Choisis un montant entier entre {1} et {2}.
options_amount_error.description: Inline error for an invalid custom amount (not saved). {1} and {2} are formatted amounts, like €1 and €500.

options_stripe.description: Small line under the amounts: the payment happens on Stripe's secure page.

options_phrase_title.description: Heading of the sentence typed by hand to end a session early for free. Also the accessible label of its field.

options_phrase_counter.description: Character counter of the sentence to type, e.g. 57 / 300. {1} is the current length, {2} the maximum.

options_phrase_error_short.en: At least {1} characters, or leave it empty.
options_phrase_error_short.fr: Au moins {1} caractères, ou laisse vide.
options_phrase_error_short.description: Inline error when the sentence to type is too short (empty means the default sentence). Nothing is saved. {1} is the minimum length (40).

options_phrase_error_long.description: Inline error when the sentence to type is too long. Nothing is saved. {1} is the maximum length (300).

options_phrase_reset.description: Button that clears the custom sentence to type so the default one is used again.

options_phrase_locked.fr: Verrouillée jusqu'à la fin du blocage.
options_phrase_locked.description: Note under the sentence field while a block is active (the field is disabled, the choice cards above stay editable). French: agrees with la phrase.

options_incognito_on.description: Status when the extension is allowed in incognito.

options_incognito_off.description: Status when the extension is not allowed in incognito.

options_incognito_button.description: Button opening the extension details page in Chrome.

options_incognito_help.en: Opens the extension details: turn on "Allow in Incognito".
options_incognito_help.fr: Ouvre les détails de l'extension : active « Autoriser en mode navigation privée ».
options_incognito_help.description: Tooltip of the incognito button. Quote the Chrome setting name as Chrome shows it.

options_reset_title.description: Title of the settings section with the Reset everything button.

options_reset_sub.en: Erase all settings and run setup again.
options_reset_sub.fr: Efface tous les réglages et refais la configuration.
options_reset_sub.description: One short line under the Start over title.

options_reset_button.description: Button that asks to reset every setting (a confirmation follows).

options_reset_confirm.en: Erase everything on every synced device? This can't be undone.
options_reset_confirm.fr: Tout effacer sur tous tes appareils synchronisés ? C'est définitif.
options_reset_confirm.description: Confirmation shown after clicking Reset everything, when no block is running. Settings are removed from Chrome sync, so from every synced device.

options_reset_confirm_block.en: This also ends the current block. Erase everything? This can't be undone.
options_reset_confirm_block.fr: Ça met aussi fin au blocage en cours. Tout effacer ? C'est définitif.
options_reset_confirm_block.description: Confirmation shown after clicking Reset everything while a block is running (the reset ends it).

options_reset_yes.description: Button that confirms the reset of every setting.

options_reset_locked.fr: Disponible à la fin du blocage.
options_reset_locked.description: Note under the Start over section when reset is locked during a block (only if the build locks it).
